Avista is hiring an Integrations Developer to support its greenfield SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud implementation. The role develops and operates integrations on SAP Integration Suite and workload automation using Redwood RunMyJobs, while supporting testing, monitoring, cutover, and post-go-live operations.
Industrial
Energy
Electrical Distribution
Energy Management
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design, build, and unit test integration flows on SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration iFlows, API Management policies, and event-based patterns
Develop mappings and transformations (Groovy, XSLT, message mapping) across REST, OData, SOAP, IDoc, and file-based interfaces
Build and maintain Redwood RunMyJobs process definitions, job chains, and schedules that automate SAP and non-SAP batch processing, file transfers, and event-driven triggers
Configure interface connectivity and security, including SAP Cloud Connector destinations, OAuth, and certificates, in partnership with BASIS and Security
Deliver assigned integration and automation objects through Design-Build-Validate sprints, meeting acceptance criteria and sprint commitments
Build monitoring, alerting, and error handling into every interface and automated job so production issues are visible and recoverable
Support system, integration, and user acceptance test cycles, resolving defects through root-cause analysis
Document interface designs, data flows, job schedules, and operational procedures
Partner with the Data and Integrations Lead, functional analysts, and the System Integrator to close design gaps and reduce rework
Support cutover, hypercare, and post-go-live operation of the integration and automation landscape
Communicate with external stakeholders (vendors) to build integrations between systems
